93 investment grow your money
every day people make choices about what to do with their money sometimes
money is saved to keep 1੮ safe and sometimes it is invested to grow over time
investment means using money today to build wealth in the future but 1ਂ also
involves risk different investment choices can give different results depending
on time and decisions in this activity you will explore how money can grow and
learn to make smart investment choices on your own
types of investments

direct equity shares direct equity means buying shares of ૧ company in the
stock market when the company does well the value of the shares can increase and
you may also get dividends
mutual funds mutual funds collect money from many people and invest 1੮ in
different companies these funds are managed by experts ১০ your money is spread
across many businesses
insurance insurance helps protect you and your family in the future some insurance
plans also help you save or grow money while giving financial protection
gold gold is ૧ popular investment that people buy to keep for ૧ long time its value
often increases over time and it is considered ੧ safe option
fixed deposit fd a fixed deposit is ੧ safe way to invest money in ૧ bank you
know how much money you will get back and when you will get it
bonds bonds are when you lend money to the government or ੧ company in return
you get interest on your money after ૧ fixed period
property investment it means buying land or buildings it can give regular income
through rent and may increase in value over time
